dialogues.speaker: Lutine
dialogues.text: Oh my, I've never seen you before, traveler. Would you like to try some of Merusea Village's specialties?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Local specialties?

dialogues.speaker: Lutine
dialogues.text: That's right. Let me introduce you. Here, we use ingredients sourced nearby to make delicious dishes that match our tastes.

dialogues.speaker: Lutine
dialogues.text: I might be tooting my own horn here, but our specialties are well-known amongst niche gourmets!

dialogues.speaker: Lutine
dialogues.text: The Steambird even included "trying Merusea Village cuisine" in their "100 Heroic Challenges to Try This Year" feature! We are No.20 on the list!

dialogues.speaker: Lutine
dialogues.text: Also, I've recently come up with a new dish. Wanna try it out?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Lutine takes out a dish with a blurry silhouette. The... stimulating scent makes your eyes swell up... This doesn't look edible. You don't think so, anyway.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do, so, no thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Lutine
dialogues.text: Oh well, that's fine. If you've got the time in the future, be sure to come try our authentic cuisine!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You love making, uh, food, do you...

dialogues.speaker: Lutine
dialogues.text: Of course! Not to brag or anything, but my food's the best in Merusea Village! I greatly treasure the expressions everyone makes after eating my dishes.

dialogues.speaker: Lutine
dialogues.text: Hehe, in fact, I can't wait to see yours. How about it? Would you like to have a go?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure, hit me with it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Contrary to its appearance, the dish is actually most refreshing. After a single bite, the pungent flavors also become... surprisingly amiable...)

dialogues.speaker: Lutine
dialogues.text: Hehe, there's lots of things you can't know till you try! My food was pretty good, huh? I could tell from your expression!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, um, cooking should require focus on all aspects, including color and scent...

dialogues.speaker: Lutine
dialogues.text: Ooh, you sound like you know a lot about cooking. Cool!

dialogues.speaker: Lutine
dialogues.text: All the more reason, then, for you to try my dish out — it's the culmination of all I know about flavors, scents, and colors!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, I'm not all that hungry right now, I'm afraid...

dialogues.speaker: Lutine
dialogues.text: *sigh* True, true. If you eat while you're very full, even the most delicious food would seem merely ordinary.

dialogues.speaker: Lutine
dialogues.text: Well then, come back when you're feeling hungry and want to try some Melusine cuisine. Don't forget, now!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the earthquake just a while ago...

dialogues.speaker: Lutine
dialogues.text: Oh, you mean from just now? Ugh, seriously, it made all the pies I made earlier drop...
